page.title: Video production
page.subtitle: Create a project from source videos, then go through: sources → script → approval → voice → scenes & images → render. Pick a channel to see its projects and open its prepared / created videos. Every file lives in the project folder.

list.empty: No projects yet. Click "New project" to start.

lock.script: Write or import a script first.
lock.approval: Approve the script first (button at the bottom of the Script tab).

form.title: New video project
form.sourcesHint: One YouTube link per line (1–5). Two or three videos on the same topic work best.
form.voiceUnavailable: VOICEVOX is not running — default voice #{{id}} will be used
form.notesPlaceholder: e.g. aimed at people over 60 living alone, avoid medical topics…
form.invalidSources: Enter at least one YouTube link

detail.select: Pick a project on the left, or create a new one.
detail.storedAtHint: project folder {{id}} (the video appears here once rendered)
detail.openVideo: Open video in a new tab
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this project and every file it produced (transcripts, voice, images, video)?

source.title: Sources
source.desc: Download the Japanese transcripts of the source videos.

script.title: Script
script.desc: Remake it with ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude from the source transcripts, or write/paste your own. Review it, then approve at the bottom to unlock Voice and Scenes.

approval.title: Approve script
approval.desc: Decide whether the script is good enough to voice. Review the checklist, the measurements and the full text below, then approve.

checks.similarity: Wording is not copied from the sources
checks.notMeasured: (not measured: source transcripts are not loaded)
checks.channel: Does not repeat the channel's earlier videos
checks.channelDetail: (compared with {{count}} earlier videos: wording, title formula)
checks.noEarlier: (no earlier videos on this channel to compare with)
checks.length: Length is inside the allowed window

approval.readHint: Approving means you read and accept this version. If it is not right, go back to the Script tab and edit it.
approval.effect: Approving unlocks the Voice and Scenes tabs. Saving the script again afterwards cancels the approval (and the voice and images made) so it must be approved again.

voice.title: Voice
voice.desc: The saved voice (VOICEVOX or ElevenLabs) reads each sentence; subtitles come from the real audio timing. If scene images already exist, their timing is re-matched to the new voice.
voice.unavailable: Cannot reach {{name}} ({{url}}). The page re-checks every 10 seconds.
voice.result: Voiced: {{duration}} ({{actual}} min), planned {{planned}} min, allowed {{min}}–{{max}} min.
voice.outside: outside the allowed window — shorten or extend the script and voice again

scenes.title: Scenes & images
scenes.desc: Split the script into scenes and draw images in the channel's visual style. No need to wait for the voice: without it, scenes are cut on estimated timing and re-timed automatically once the voice exists. Can take a long time.

timing.provisional: Scene timing is estimated from the script for now. Once the voice is made, scenes are re-timed to it automatically.
timing.voice: Scene timing matches the real voice.

scenes.redoConfirm: Redoing everything re-cuts the scenes and redraws all {{count}} images (current images are deleted). To fix a few scenes, use "Redraw" on each scene below. Continue?

video.title: Render video
video.desc: Combine images, voice and subtitles into a 1080p video. Needs both the voice and the scene images.

motion.title: Image → video
motion.desc: Optional: animate scene images into short clips with Google Flow (Veo) or Muse, run in Chrome on profiles with Flow / Muse ticked in LLM Video. Scenes with a clip play it in the video; the rest stay images with Ken Burns. Skip this step to build the video from images as before.

metadata.title: Metadata & thumbnail
metadata.desc: Write the YouTube title, description and tags and draw the thumbnail with the channel's metadata prompts and thumbnail style (same as the channel's prepared videos). The metadata is written from the narration subtitles, so it does not wait for the render. Runs in Chrome and can take a few minutes.
metadata.redoConfirm: Creating again overwrites the title, description, tags (including your edits) and the current thumbnail. Continue?

remake.title: Remake with ChatGPT / Gemini
remake.hint: Opens a Chrome profile with the text LLM ticked and runs the "Remake script" prompt over the source transcripts. The LLM picks a length of 12–30 minutes. Edit the prompt on the Prompts page.
remake.imported: Remake result taken as the script

editor.title: Write / paste script
editor.hint: A "# Title" line, each chapter starting with "## 1. Chapter name", one sentence per line. You can paste a script written elsewhere (for example following the manual test guide).
editor.saveNote: Saving re-measures similarity and cancels any approval, voice and images already made.

summary.title: Measurements
summary.noSimilarity: No source transcripts yet, so similarity to the sources was not measured.
summary.freshness: Against {{count}} earlier videos of this channel
summary.warn: Some measurements fail. You can still approve, but fix them to avoid being treated as reused or templated content.

voicePreview.failed: Preview failed — check that VOICEVOX is running

scenes.title: Scenes ({{count}})
scenes.hint: Click an image to enlarge. "Redraw" uses the current prompt; "Edit prompt" to rewrite it first.

narration.title: Narration: {{chapters}} chapters · {{sentences}} sentences · {{duration}}
narration.hint: Click a sentence to hear just that sentence, or a chapter button to hear the whole chapter.
narration.misaligned: The voice no longer matches the current script (edited after narration) — timings are approximate; regenerate the voice.

channel.noStyle: no visual style — scenes cannot be made
channel.scenesConfirm: Existing scene images were drawn in the old channel's style. They are kept; regenerate scenes for the new style. Any rendered video must be rebuilt. Continue?

motion.channelImages: This channel is set to image-based video — pick intro or every scene to add motion.
motion.channelDefault: Default from the channel's video type: {{mode}}.
motion.summary: {{targets}} scenes selected, {{done}} already have a clip · project: {{clips}}/{{total}} scenes are video
motion.frozen: {{count}} scenes are longer than {{clip}}s: a clip lasts {{clip}}s, so the rest holds the last frame (~{{sec}}s in total). For all-video, use high scene density (short scenes) when making scenes.
motion.promptCopied: Copied the clip prompt for scene #{{index}} — paste it into Flow with the scene image, then use Replace clip to bring the mp4 in.
motion.replaced: Replaced the clip for scene #{{index}}. Rebuild the video to use it.

providerHint.flow: Uses the Flow quota of profiles with Flow ticked in LLM Video; switches profile when one runs out.
providerHint.muse: Runs on muse.ai with a profile that has Muse ticked in LLM Video (must be logged into muse.ai). Clips are 3–10 s, made one scene at a time; if Muse reports its video service is down, the remaining scenes keep their image.
providerHint.meta: Runs on Meta AI with a profile that has Meta ticked in LLM Image (same Meta account). Sends the scene image with the prompt "Create video 16:9 …", one scene at a time; switches profile when one runs out of quota. Meta picks the clip length; assembly cuts it to fit the scene.

channelVideo.search: Search videos by title or ID…
channelVideo.empty: This channel has no preparing, prepared or created videos yet.

source.hint: The YouTube source video this video is remade from.
source.starting: Creating the video folder from the skill script…

script.remakeHint: Remake channel: rewrite the script from the source transcript with ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude (same prompt sets as projects), then press "Use the result as the script". You can edit it by hand below.
script.fromSkill: Script written ahead by the nightly skill (check passed {{date}}). For another one, remake above, use the result and narrate again.

voice.title: VOICEVOX narration
voice.presetInfo: {{speaker}} · pitch {{pitch}} · intonation {{intonation}} · volume {{volume}} · pause {{pause}}. Speed is prefilled from the saved voice ({{speed}}) and can be changed.
voice.hint: Reads the script from the Script tab. The narration replaces the video's audio and subtitles; the source video's audio and transcript are kept in the source/ folder.
voice.rescenes: Re-reading the voice moves the existing scenes onto the new voice timing. If the script changed a lot, the app tells you to regenerate the scenes.
voice.sourceKept: The source video's original audio is kept at source/audio.mp3.
voice.scenesStale: The script changed a lot since the scenes were made (only {{percent}}% of sentences kept): the images no longer match the narration. Press "Regenerate scenes" on the Scenes tab, then render again.

readings.title: Check readings ({{count}} words)
readings.hint: Numbers, names, Latin words and kanji with two readings in the script, with how VOICEVOX read the first sentence containing each. If a reading is wrong, write the right one in katakana: only the voice changes, the script and subtitles stay as written. Then read the voice again; only sentences with that word are re-read.

metadata.empty: No metadata yet. Use the button above to create it.
metadata.title: Title

sourcePicker.title: Pick from the channel's sources
sourcePicker.hint: Videos from the target channel's source channels not processed yet: not prepared for the channel and not used as a source by another project of the channel. Pick one video at a time; picking another replaces the link in the box above.
sourcePicker.empty: No unprocessed source videos left. Check the source channels in the channel settings, or paste links above.

voicePick.label: Voice
voicePick.customHint: Pick a voice and tune it for this video only — it is not added to the saved voices in Settings.
